card.name: Word endings in fixed phrases
card.fires_on: The final piece of a longer word that completes a very common fixed phrase, mostly the end of "Sodium Chloride" in dilution instructions. It also fires on "subcapsular" and on "Japan" after "west coast of".

modes.label: Sodium Chloride ending
modes.description: The closing "ide" of "Chloride" in diluent names such as 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection.
modes.example: Dilute with 0.9% Sodium Chlor<<ide>> Injection, USP or 5%

modes.label: Other word completions
modes.description: The closing part of a medical term that is nearly certain, such as "subcapsular" or "Acetate".
modes.example: may result in posterior subcaps<<ular>> cataract formation.

modes.label: Country after coast
modes.description: The country name "Japan" ending a geographic phrase.
